newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen staying flat or down on Wed.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen staying flat or down on Wed.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend their current flat trend and possibly fall after Tuesday's virtually flat market which was followed by stronger selling after price fixing and at continuous trade.

Analysts said a deeper fall could be prevented by the U.S. federal reserve's decision not to raise interest rates on Tuesday but that a stronger impulse would likely be needed for the Warsaw bourse to form a growth trend in the near term.
They said the large public offering of Bank Handlowy starting in late May would likely dampen bourse buying. @
Construction materials maker Bauma starts trade on the parallel market on Wednesday.
